binary_format.dictionary_index_record: dict.idx: uint32 dat_offset, uint32 record_size; records separated by CRLF in dict.dat
binary_format.dictionary_record: UTF-8 key, CRLF, uint32 block_number, uint32 entry_in_block
binary_format.compressed_index_record: dict.zdx: uint32 zdt_offset, uint32 compressed_size; blocks separated by CRLF in dict.zdt
binary_format.compressed_block: uint32 entry_count followed by entry_count pairs of uint32 payload_offset and uint32 payload_size; payload bytes begin at 4 + entry_count*8

representation.payload: one TEI entryFree per addressed payload, retaining source subtree order, text, tail text, n attributes, lists, line breaks, and reference display text
representation.attribute_crosswalk: source ref/@osisRef becomes TEI P5 ref/@target plus type=osisRef; source ref/@target remains target
representation.dictionary_key_crosswalk: every external dictionary key is represented literally in readable TEI form/orth and every binary pointer is recorded against the same ordinal TEI xml:id
representation.terminal_nul_disposition: each addressed payload must contain exactly one final NUL byte; it is retained in source hashes and explicitly disposed as a required binary format terminator outside readable TEI
representation.allocation_padding_disposition: each indexed compressed allocation contains one complete zlib stream followed by exactly 1024 zero bytes, retained and explicitly disposed as verified allocation padding

metadata_policy: Use only the assigned work identity and exact module metadata; do not infer a print edition, silently repair source wording, or promote module claims to human acceptance.
rights_policy: Retain the module Public Domain statement and provider/source attribution while leaving human rights and publication decisions unresolved.
